create_SE_instance: create a SentEval engine instance with params, batcher, and optional prepare function
eval_single_task: evaluate a sentence embedding model on a single SentEval task like SST2 or STSBenchmark
eval_multiple_tasks: evaluate a sentence embedding model on a list of SentEval tasks and return results dict
configure_SE_params: configure SentEval engine parameters including batch_size, seed, kfold, and classifier hidden units
run_probing_tasks: run linguistic probing tasks like Length, Tense, Depth, and WordContent to test representation quality
